# R Package Development

## Package Structure

```
packagename/
├── R/                    # Source code
│   ├── cleaning.R
│   ├── analysis.R
│   └── utils.R
├── tests/
│   └── testthat/
│       ├── test-cleaning.R
│       └── test-analysis.R
├── man/                  # Generated by roxygen2 (don't edit)
├── data/                 # Package data (small reference data only)
├── inst/                 # Files installed with package
├── vignettes/            # Long-form documentation
├── DESCRIPTION           # Package metadata
├── NAMESPACE             # Generated by roxygen2 (don't edit)
├── .Rbuildignore         # Files excluded from package build
├── .gitignore
├── renv.lock
└── README.md
```

## Scaffolding with usethis

```r
# Create package
usethis::create_package("packagename")

# Add infrastructure
usethis::use_testthat()
usethis::use_readme_md()
usethis::use_mit_license()
usethis::use_git()
usethis::use_renv()

# Add a new R file + test
usethis::use_r("module_name")
usethis::use_test("module_name")

# Add dependencies
usethis::use_package("data.table")
usethis::use_package("ggplot2", type = "Suggests")
```

## DESCRIPTION File

```
Package: packagename
Title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
Version: 0.1.0
Authors@R:
    person("First", "Last", email = "first.last@worldbank.org",
           role = c("aut", "cre"))
Description: What the package does. One paragraph.
License: MIT + file LICENSE
Encoding: UTF-8
Roxygen: list(markdown = TRUE)
RoxygenNote: 7.3.0
Imports:
    data.table,
    rlang,
    cli
Suggests:
    testthat (>= 3.0.0),
    ggplot2,
    withr
Config/testthat/edition: 3
```

## roxygen2 Documentation

```r
#' Clean and harmonize income variable
#'
#' @param dt A [data.table] with raw survey data.
#' @param income_var Character. Name of the income column.
#' @param ppp Numeric. PPP conversion factor. Default is 1.
#'
#' @return A [data.table] with cleaned `income_ppp` column added.
#'
#' @export
#'
#' @examples
#' dt <- data.table(id = 1:3, hh_income = c(1000, 2000, NA))
#' clean_income(dt, "hh_income", ppp = 1.9)
clean_income <- function(dt, income_var, ppp = 1) {
  stopifnot(is.data.table(dt))
  stopifnot(income_var %in% names(dt))

  dt[, income_ppp := get(income_var) / ppp]

  return(dt)
}
```

## Error Handling with rlang + cli

```r
# Preferred error/warning pattern
my_function <- function(dt, col) {
  if (!is.data.table(dt)) {
    cli::cli_abort("{.arg dt} must be a {.cls data.table}, not {.cls {class(dt)}}.")
  }
  if (!col %in% names(dt)) {
    cli::cli_abort("Column {.val {col}} not found in {.arg dt}.")
  }
}

# Try-catch pattern
result <- rlang::try_fetch(
  risky_operation(),
  error = function(e) {
    cli::cli_warn("Operation failed: {conditionMessage(e)}")
    NULL
  }
)
```

## Development Workflow

```r
# 1. Write code in R/
# 2. Write tests in tests/testthat/
# 3. Document
devtools::document()      # Generate man/ and NAMESPACE from roxygen2

# 4. Check
devtools::check()         # Full R CMD check

# 5. Test
devtools::test()          # Run all tests

# 6. Install locally
devtools::install()       # Install the package
```

## renv Workflow

```r
renv::init()       # Initialize renv for the project
renv::snapshot()   # Save current package state to renv.lock
renv::restore()    # Restore packages from renv.lock
renv::status()     # Check if renv.lock is in sync
```

Commit `renv.lock` to git. Do NOT commit `renv/library/`.

## .Rbuildignore Patterns

```r
# Add entries to .Rbuildignore
usethis::use_build_ignore("^\.cg-docs$")
usethis::use_build_ignore("^compound-gpid\.local\.md$")
usethis::use_build_ignore("^\.github$")
```
